content.name: Aylin Demir
content.title: Stationsleitung Intensivstation (ICU Nurse Manager)
content.summary: Registered nurse (Gesundheits- und Krankenpflegerin) with a specialist qualification in intensive care and anaesthesia nursing and 16 years in German hospitals, the last five managing a 20-bed interdisciplinary ICU. I led the unit through its first external audit for the DIVI quality indicators and reduced nurse turnover from 19% to 9%.

experience.title: Gesundheits- und Krankenpflegerin (General Surgery)
bullets: Provided post-operative care for 8–10 patients per shift on a 36-bed general and visceral surgery ward.
Took on the ward's wound care link role and standardised dressing documentation for 120+ chronic wound patients a year.
Trained 3 cohorts of Auszubildende as Praxisanleiterin after completing the 200-hour practice instructor qualification.

experience.title: Intensive Care Nurse (Fachkrankenpflegerin from 2016)
bullets: Cared for 2–3 ventilated patients per shift in a 14-bed surgical ICU, managing ECMO, CRRT and invasive haemodynamic monitoring.
Completed the two-year DKG specialist training in intensive and anaesthesia nursing alongside full-time work.
Introduced a nurse-led weaning protocol with the senior physicians, reducing average ventilation days from 6.8 to 5.4.

experience.title: Stellvertretende Stationsleitung (Deputy Nurse Manager), ICU
bullets: Deputised for the nurse manager of a 20-bed interdisciplinary ICU with 74 nursing staff.
Coordinated the expansion to 26 ventilation-capable beds during the COVID-19 pandemic, including cross-training 31 nurses from other wards.
Built a structured onboarding plan for nurses recognised from abroad, used for 12 colleagues from the Philippines, Tunisia and India.

experience.title: Stationsleitung Intensivstation (ICU Nurse Manager)
bullets: Lead 78 nursing staff and manage a personnel budget of €4.6 million, meeting the statutory minimum ICU nurse staffing ratios (PpUGV) every month since 2022.
Cut nurse turnover from 19% to 9% in three years by introducing self-scheduling, protected training days and a mentoring scheme.
Prepared the unit for its first external peer review against the DIVI intensive care quality indicators, closing 11 of 12 recommended actions within a year.
Reduced central line infections from 2.9 to 1.1 per 1,000 catheter days with a bundle checklist and weekly bedside audits.

achievements.title: Berufserlaubnis (licence to practise)
achievements.detail: Holds permission to use the protected title Gesundheits- und Krankenpflegerin, granted in 2010.

achievements.title: Hospital innovation award, 2023
achievements.detail: For the ICU self-scheduling model, later adopted by two other wards.
